research_routes.projection: A pull-request source head and GitHub's synthesized integration/merge ref are different software subjects. Normal pull_request execution targets the merge subject by default; explicit checkout of the PR head SHA targets the source head.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Require a predeclared evaluation target and preserve source, base, integration and executed subject coordinates separately. A green source-head test cannot be silently promoted into integration-result authority.

research_routes.route: Git object model and intrinsic state identity
research_routes.projection: A Git tree identifies recursive content state, whereas a commit adds parent/history and metadata around a tree. Identical tree state therefore does not establish identical revision/history identity.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Introduce tree-scoped partial identification. Matching integration and executed trees can support content-state authority while exact revision identity remains unresolved.

research_routes.projection: Trustworthy execution claims separate the subject digest from builder/run provenance, resolved dependencies and verification identity. Provenance authenticates what process/subject was observed; it does not itself establish scientific correctness.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Treat execution-subject attestation as an observation layer feeding PromotionGate rather than as proof that the evaluated scientific method is correct. Open transitive evaluator-dependency identity as its own fiber.

research_routes.projection: Workflow text can remain unchanged while third-party action tags resolve to action implementations. GitHub recommends pinning an action to a full-length commit SHA when immutable action identity is required.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Open META_N029_EVALUATOR_DEPENDENCY_PINNING. Evaluator integrity must eventually bind the transitive implementation identity of actions/tools/runtime inputs, not just the repository workflow text. Do not mutate the protected workflow until this child fiber has its own frozen benchmark.

retained_semantic_objects.meaning: Source revision, base revision, synthesized integration revision/tree and actually executed revision/tree are separate coordinates of the evaluation subject.
Authority must state in advance whether evaluation targets the source head or an integration result; the target cannot be inferred opportunistically from a passing run.
Matching content trees can justify tree/state-level identification while revision/history identity remains unresolved; this partial result must not be upgraded globally.
Downstream gates still need explicit rules for which subject scope is sufficient for which claim, for example behavior-on-content versus reproducibility-of-exact-revision.
The round-008 CI log showed tagged actions resolving to concrete action commits at runtime. Frozen workflow text therefore does not by itself freeze the complete evaluator implementation.

deduplication_notes: Git commit/tree scope was introduced conceptually in round 007. Round 008 counts only its new operational consequence: tree-only subject attestation and partial authority.
External observation and candidate-self-report rejection already existed in evaluator-integrity work; they are benchmarked here but are not counted as new semantic objects.
Artifact attestation and SLSA provenance are used as projections for subject/run/dependency separation, not imported as scientific truth criteria.
META_N029 is opened from a native CI observation plus primary GitHub security guidance; no protected evaluator workflow is changed in this round.
